verdict.rationale: Omnara documents a REST API with a dedicated API section (e.g., authentication docs) and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.omnara.com/openapi.json. That is the foundation for an API reference, and the llms.txt index also makes the docs AI-friendly. Nothing in the pack, however, shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser try-it or playground, runnable request/response examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
